title: MemeBlip2: A Novel Light Weight Multimodal System to Detect Harmful Memes
reasoning: The paper focuses on the detection of harmful memes (hate speech and harassment) using a multimodal vision-language model. While this is a task within AI safety and ethics, the paper does not evaluate or benchmark religion, faith, spiritual traditions, or formal moral/theological systems; it focuses on binary classification of harm as defined by the PrideMM dataset.
